description: Geodeetiliste punktide andmekogu (WMS) is a dataset listed in Estonian National Geoportal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by teenus-ogc-ms.geoportaal.ee. The service contains the data of the database of geodetic points: 1) National Geodetic Network 2)Gravimetric network 3) Local Geodetic Network 4) Altitude grid 5) Theme map of the condition of geodetic signs. Coverage: EE. The portal shows the English title as "Geodetic Point Database (WMS)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include geodeetiline võrk, MaRu wms, gravimeetriline võrk, kõrgusvõrk, kohalik geodeetiline võrk, gpa. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2026-04-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ng-ee.
